name: empathy
title_zh: 动笔前先过一遍人类沟通守则的 AI 助手
tagline_zh: PR、评论、邮件、聊天……凡是要给人看的文字，先读规则再落笔。省得发出去才后悔，收回来又尴尬。
tagline_en: For PRs, comments, emails, chats—anything a person will read. Loads the rules first, so you don't regret sending.
desc_en: Rules for communicating with humans as an AI agent. Read in full BEFORE composing any text another person will read: PR titles and descriptions, issues, code review replies, comments, discussion summaries, emails, chat and forum posts, commit messages, changelogs. Also before replying when someone responds to you, and before deciding whether to post at all. Do not draft first and check after. Mini
why_zh: 它不是事后检查，而是前置约束。在起草任何对外文本前强制加载规则，从源头减少冒犯与误解。
why_en: Enforces rules before drafting, not after. Cuts friction and faux pas at the source.
limit_zh: 仅约束 AI 生成的对外文本，不覆盖语音、表情符号或非文字媒介；若你已习惯手动检查，此技能可能显得多余。
limit_en: Text-only; no voice, emoji, or visual media. Redundant if you already self-check every message.
title_en: AI that reads human-communication rules before you write
